resources.name: Material constants of ZTS-19 FC and clay (Table 1)

access.notes: Full sets of electromechanical constants for ZTS-19 ferroelectric ceramic and for clay are provided directly in the task instruction (extracted from Table 1 of the paper).
Install via pip (numpy, scipy) for matrix computations and general numerics.
Any open-source FEM library (e.g., FEniCS, scikit-fem) is acceptable; the agent may choose an equivalent implementation.
